name: EPIC 248880861
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 7.9 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248880861 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.865267 (16th-84th percentiles 7.53567-8.214065), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248880861 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.053477 (16th-84th percentiles 0.95356-1.166653), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248880861: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5111.1626 +/- 51 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248880861 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4169.804688 (16th-84th percentiles 4034.765625-4310.507812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,170 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.05 solar masses and 7.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,111 K at its surface.
